brandNote.text:
HCIG in the picture, B and D

Your ask: show who we are in the image itself, like the original and J.

B 1 Beacon: the HC mark sits where the flows meet, over Egypt, and pulses.
B 2 Network: the HC mark drawn as points and links on the Earth, drawing itself in.
B 3 Watermark: a large faint HC mark in space, like the original.

D 1 The full HCIG logo etched into the boardroom window.
D 2 The HC mark alone, etched larger in the window.
D 3 A large faint HC mark over the window.

Real logo files only, never redrawn. Each works by night and by day (press the sun). Pick one per hero, or say mix.

filmGroup.text: Group section: the full film, with sound

filmHero.text: Hero B with the group film, looping in the picture

filmNote.text:
The group film, new boards

1. Hero B with the film: a copy of B where the 30 second film loops in the picture, on the right where the flows meet. B and its watermark stay on the other pages as they were.
2. Group section: the full film, with a sound button, and the eight brands under it. On phones the tall cut fills the width.

Press Play on a board to see the film move. Nothing on the other pages was changed.

fourNote.text:
Four heroes, night and day

1. Press the sun or the moon in the header of any board (best in Play). Day comes in from the east with a soft light line and a sun flare; words and logo change halfway.
2. B: the drawn routes are gone. Light now runs along the flows that are in the photo itself, toward Egypt.
3. D and J: the same photos by day (made in your Gemini). J's HC mark turns from white to black.
4. O is today's healthcareig.com hero, polished: the same order (partner banner, the doctors, the turquoise line, the lead as the headline, Talk to our team), with the real logo and mark, seals on plates, motion, night and day. Day is its starting look, as on the live site.
5. Fonts: Helma at the weight the live site shows it, Inter for text. Turquoise #12C0C6.
6. Become a Partner sits beside Talk to our team on all four.
7. Phones rebuilt phone-first: the photo is a band at the top that melts into the page, the words below it, both buttons on the first screen down to 360 px wide.
8. HCIG in the picture (your picks): B the large faint HC mark in space, D the HC mark etched in the boardroom glass. The other options stay on the first page.

open.text: The twelve heroes as first shown, kept for reference. His pick: B, D, J and the original, on the first page with night and day.

finalTitle.text: Final: hero B with the group film, then the group section

finalNote.text:
The final page, my picks

1. Hero: B, the Earth at night with the light flows. The group film plays in the picture where the flows meet, so HCIG and its eight brands are in the image itself.
2. Below it: the group section, the full 30 second film with a sound button and the eight brands.
3. One switch: the sun or the moon in the header turns the whole page, hero and section together.
4. Brand colours only: Black, Dim Gray, Turquoise, White. At night the accent words are Turquoise; by day they are Black with a Turquoise line.
5. Phones first: the photo strip melts into the page with no seam when you switch.

The four heroes, the film boards and the twelve stay on their pages.

Your brief: less content, more structure, meaning; know us just by looking. Hero B with the film and the group section stay; every other section is remade.

The order: hero, the group in numbers, who we are, the group, the patient journey, what we deliver, for partners, global reach, voices, partner with us.

Every fact comes from the live site. Copy is shorter and edited. Brand colours and fonts only.

VERSION 1 · FINAL B (THE GLOBAL HEALTHCARE NETWORK)

Design Philosophy:
High-tech global coordination ecosystem. Built for international insurers, assistance networks, and cross-border partners.

Aesthetic System:
Obsidian dark space grounds (#04070D), cyber-turquoise data lines (#12C0C6), frosted glassmorphic bento cards, and real-time telemetry route projection.

All 12 sections built with dedicated Version B components. 100% of live client wording preserved word for word.

40-year clinical pedigree and institutional hospital excellence. Built for hospital boards, physicians, and private patients.

Architectural alabaster (#FFFFFF), clinical navy (#0A2A4A), Helma serif display, genuine physician & facility photography, and formal GHA/DMWV accreditation seals.

All 12 sections built with dedicated Version O components. 100% of live client wording preserved word for word.
